rationale: The repeated response measures submitted priority in command units, with its transient generated by the recorder. It supplies neither an end-to-end delay measurement nor a conversion to hours, so it cannot establish the claimed two-hour reduction, even at the tested operating point.

signal_basis.exact_text: The archived trajectory is the smoothed submitted-priority register in command units.
In each of three repetitions it settles two units below its initial value after the step and returns after reversal.
The acquisition filter generates the transient from the submitted command before the work-item scheduler acts.
The register records submitted input, not queue state, completion times or application to work items.
No process-output channel or conversion from command units to delay is supplied.
